variableTemplates.name: standardFamily
variableTemplates.description: Standard family identifier. Fixed value: GBBC_IWA_DMRV.

variableTemplates.name: standardVersion
variableTemplates.description: GBBC/IWA dMRV specification version this Extension Set is built against.

variableTemplates.name: extensionSetId
variableTemplates.description: This Extension Set's identifier.

variableTemplates.name: extensionSetVersion
variableTemplates.description: Semantic version of this Extension Set.

variableTemplates.name: methodologySystem
variableTemplates.description: Sovereign methodology system name. Verified live value: VRE_PARFE_SOVEREIGN_DMRV (HCS topic 0.0.8585272, seq 374200).

variableTemplates.name: methodologyAuthority
variableTemplates.description: Sovereign methodology authority. Verified live value: VRE_PARFE.

variableTemplates.name: methodologyId
variableTemplates.description: Sovereign methodology identifier. Verified live value: VP-CO2E-RE-GRID-001.

variableTemplates.name: methodologyVersion
variableTemplates.description: Sovereign methodology version. Verified live value: V1.

variableTemplates.name: qualityStandardRole
variableTemplates.description: Declares this methodology's role relative to the IWA Quality Standard concept. Proposed value: SOVEREIGN_DIGITAL_DMRV_METHOD.

variableTemplates.name: externalMethodologyAuthority
variableTemplates.description: Authority of the referenced external methodology. Verified live value: UNFCCC_CDM.

variableTemplates.name: externalMethodologyId
variableTemplates.description: External methodology code. Must be explicit in governed CO2_METHOD_SCOPE_GRANT evidence and must not be silently defaulted by runtime code. Verified live value: AMS-I.D from governance topic 0.0.8479702 seq 76-77, replayed into passport seq 374200 and confirmation seq 374205.

variableTemplates.name: externalMethodologyName
variableTemplates.description: Human-readable name of the external methodology. Verified live value: Small-scale grid-connected renewable electricity.

variableTemplates.name: documentVersion
variableTemplates.description: Version of the external methodology's source document, if referenced. Not yet populated in live data -- proposed field.

variableTemplates.name: documentRef
variableTemplates.description: Reference/URL to the external methodology source document. Proposed field, not yet populated in live data.

variableTemplates.name: documentHash
variableTemplates.description: SHA-256 hash of the external methodology source document, for tamper-evidence. Proposed field.

variableTemplates.name: validationRefCodes
variableTemplates.description: Array of validation reference codes. Must be explicit in governed CO2_METHOD_SCOPE_GRANT evidence. Verified live value includes ARTICLE_6_4_PRINCIPLES from governance topic 0.0.8479702 seq 76-77.

variableTemplates.name: dependencyStatus
variableTemplates.description: States that the external methodology reference is not an issuance dependency. Proposed value: REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_ISSUANCE_AUTHORITY.

variableTemplates.name: mode
variableTemplates.description: Declares CO2's verification posture. Proposed value: CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_AND_VERIFICATION_VIA_REC_EVIDENCE -- 'via REC evidence' because CO2 does not monitor telemetry directly; it verifies the REC evidence it allocates from.

variableTemplates.name: verificationEngine
variableTemplates.description: Identifies the automated system performing verification at the REC/telemetry layer, whose result CO2 inherits by traversal. Proposed value: VRE_PARFE_EDGE_NOTARY_AND_HCS_REPLAY.

variableTemplates.name: sourceOfTruth
variableTemplates.description: Declares HCS as the primary evidentiary source of truth, replacing a VVB report as the origin object. Proposed value: HCS.

variableTemplates.name: recEvidenceValidityStatus
variableTemplates.description: CO2's own gate: whether every entry in parentRecEvidence resolves to a valid, minted, non-revoked REC token record at its stated finalHcsTopicId/finalHcsSequence. This is what CO2 actually depends on -- issued REC evidence, not raw telemetry. Verified live value PASSED in the five-envelope passport/confirmation.

variableTemplates.name: methodologyGovernanceStatus
variableTemplates.description: CO2's own gate: whether methodScope is current and active against the governance topic (governanceTopicId/methodScopeHcsSequence). Verified live value PASSED in five-envelope passport/confirmation; fresh methodScopeHcsSequence is 77.

variableTemplates.name: gefScopeGovernanceStatus
variableTemplates.description: CO2's own gate: whether gefScope (grantId, methodologyId, methodologyVersion, gefValueKgPerKwh) is current and active against its governance grant. Verified live value PASSED in the five-envelope passport/confirmation.

variableTemplates.name: allocationReconciliationStatus
variableTemplates.description: CO2's own gate: whether sum(allocations[].consumedMgCO2e) equals quantityMgCO2e. Renamed from an earlier draft's 'calculationReplayStatus' for precision -- this checks arithmetic reconciliation of REC allocation into the tonne-lot, not a telemetry-level replay. Verified fresh live math: 491,200,000 + 508,800,000 = 1,000,000,000, backed by Equation 2 in FormulaTemplates.json.

variableTemplates.name: auditReplayStatus
variableTemplates.description: Whether this CO2 passport's own evidence chain can be replayed from public HCS records and traced onward through its parentRecEvidence into the REC evidence layer. Value REPLAYABLE_VIA_REC (not 'from telemetry') reflects that CO2's direct dependency stops at REC; further replay from REC down into raw telemetry is the REC passport's own property. Backed by Equation 3 (Replay Completeness) in FormulaTemplates.json.

variableTemplates.name: assuranceModel
variableTemplates.description: Names the assurance model this passport operates under. Proposed value: SYSTEM_CONTROLS_AND_EVIDENCE_REPLAY, distinguishing it from VVB-report-based assurance.

variableTemplates.name: auditorRole
variableTemplates.description: Describes what an auditor does under this model: review and replay controls, not originate trust. Proposed value: INDEPENDENT_REPLAY_AND_CONTROL_ASSURANCE.

variableTemplates.name: vvbDependency
variableTemplates.description: States whether a VVB is required for this issuance path. Proposed value: NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_PREPRODUCTION_OR_AUTOMATED_ISSUANCE.

variableTemplates.name: vvbUseWhereRequired
variableTemplates.description: Enumerates the specific situations where a VVB is still referenced: methodology recognition, sovereign approval, external assurance, Article 6/compliance use.

variableTemplates.name: schemaVersion
variableTemplates.description: Version of the SCHEMAS_V2.js frozen telemetry schema in force at the REC/telemetry layer when the underlying evidence was recorded.

variableTemplates.name: governanceTopicId
variableTemplates.description: HCS topic holding the sovereign governance spine (LICENSE_GRANT / GATEWAY_DEPLOY / SENSOR_LINK / methodScope records) that governs this CO2 methodology. Verified live value: 0.0.8479702 (methodScope.hcsTopicId; explicit AMS-I.D method-scope grant at seq 76-77).

variableTemplates.name: mintEventsTopicId
variableTemplates.description: HCS topic where the CO2 passport and confirmation messages are written. Verified live value: 0.0.8585272 (co2Passport.hcsTopicId, and the topic the confirmation message itself was submitted to).

variableTemplates.name: methodScopeHcsSequence
variableTemplates.description: HCS sequence number of the governing methodScope record. Verified fresh live value: 77 (methodScope.hcsSequence, topic 0.0.8479702) after explicit AMS-I.D governance update at seq 76-78.

variableTemplates.name: passportHcsSequence
variableTemplates.description: HCS sequence number of the CO2_REGULATORY_PASSPORT message. Verified fresh live value: 374200, carrying AMS-I.D and methodScopeHcsSequence 77.

variableTemplates.name: confirmationHcsSequence
variableTemplates.description: HCS sequence number of the CO2_OFFSET_LOT_CONFIRMATION message. Verified fresh live value: 374205, carrying AMS-I.D and minted HTS serial 31371.

variableTemplates.name: assetType
variableTemplates.description: Type of asset being issued. Verified live value: CO2_TONNE_LOT.

variableTemplates.name: claimType
variableTemplates.description: Type of claim the issued unit represents. Verified live value: SOVEREIGN_CO2E_DISPLACEMENT_CLAIM.

variableTemplates.name: quantityMgCO2e
variableTemplates.description: Issued quantity in milligrams CO2e (integer, avoids floating point rounding at scale). Verified live value: 1000000000.

variableTemplates.name: quantityKgCO2e
variableTemplates.description: Issued quantity in kilograms CO2e, derived via Equation 1. Verified live value: '1000.000000'.

variableTemplates.name: unit
variableTemplates.description: Unit label for the issued quantity. Proposed value: tCO2e. Not currently emitted as an explicit field in the live payload (quantity is implied by quantityKgCO2e alone).

variableTemplates.name: tokenId
variableTemplates.description: HTS token ID of the minted CO2e unit. Verified live value: 0.0.8585274.

variableTemplates.name: serial
variableTemplates.description: HTS NFT serial number of the minted CO2e unit. Verified fresh live value: 31371.

variableTemplates.name: htsTxId
variableTemplates.description: Hedera transaction ID of the mint. Verified fresh live value: 0.0.8411690-1783339679-479003501.

variableTemplates.name: lifecycleStatus
variableTemplates.description: Explicit lifecycle state machine for the issued unit: MINTED | TRANSFERRED | RETIRED | CANCELLED | SUSPENDED | REVOKED. Live payloads currently use ad hoc status strings (PASSPORT_SUBMITTED, CO2_TONNE_LOT_MINTED) instead of this enum -- proposed replacement/superset.

variableTemplates.name: retirementStatus
variableTemplates.description: Whether the unit has been retired against a claim. Proposed value: NOT_RETIRED | RETIRED. Not present in live data.

variableTemplates.name: consumedMgCO2e
variableTemplates.description: mgCO2e consumed from a single parent-REC allocation entry into the tonne-lot. Verified fresh live values: 491200000 and 508800000, summing to 1000000000.

variableTemplates.name: type
variableTemplates.description: Top-level passport message type. Required live value: CO2_REGULATORY_PASSPORT.

variableTemplates.name: co2ClaimId
variableTemplates.description: Top-level sovereign CO2 claim identifier for the passport record.

variableTemplates.name: lotId
variableTemplates.description: Top-level CO2 tonne-lot identifier.

variableTemplates.name: scopeKey
variableTemplates.description: Top-level governed CO2 scope key for the passport.

variableTemplates.name: claim
variableTemplates.description: Top-level claim object containing the sovereign CO2e claim, methodology, market alignment, and validation status fields.

variableTemplates.name: accounting
variableTemplates.description: Top-level accounting object describing boundary, calculation method, baseline, leakage, deductions, uncertainty, and netting rules.

variableTemplates.name: parentRecEvidence
variableTemplates.description: Top-level array of parent REC evidence references used by CO2 to traverse into the REC layer.

variableTemplates.name: gefScope
variableTemplates.description: Top-level governed emission-factor scope object.

variableTemplates.name: methodScope
variableTemplates.description: Top-level governed CO2 methodology scope object.

variableTemplates.name: standardEnvelope
variableTemplates.description: Top-level canonical standard envelope object.

variableTemplates.name: externalMethodology
variableTemplates.description: Top-level external methodology object. Runtime MUST reject missing or defaulted externalMethodology.methodologyId.

variableTemplates.name: continuousVerification
variableTemplates.description: Top-level CO2 continuous verification object.

variableTemplates.name: auditAssurance
variableTemplates.description: Top-level audit assurance and control evidence object.

variableTemplates.name: issuedUnit
variableTemplates.description: Top-level issued CO2 unit object.

variableTemplates.name: allocations
variableTemplates.description: Top-level array reconciling parent REC evidence into the CO2 tonne-lot quantity.

variableTemplates.name: netCo2eMg
variableTemplates.description: Top-level net CO2e quantity in milligrams. Kept alongside tonneLotMgCO2e for current live schema compatibility.

variableTemplates.name: tonneLotMgCO2e
variableTemplates.description: Top-level tonne-lot CO2e quantity in milligrams. Currently duplicates netCo2eMg and is retained for schema compatibility.

variableTemplates.name: status
variableTemplates.description: Top-level passport submission status. Verified live value: PASSPORT_SUBMITTED.

variableTemplates.name: ts
variableTemplates.description: Top-level ISO-8601 timestamp when the passport record was emitted.

variableTemplates.name: meta
variableTemplates.description: Top-level issuer and network metadata object.
